blocks.text: While she opted to keep her silence amid rumors surrounding her supposed pregnancy, Sarah Geronimo gave fans an update, showing off her shorter hairdo to welcome the month of November. The actress-singer flaunted her hairstyle through her social media pages last Thursday, Nov. 5. “Hello, November! A little change to welcome the new month,” she captioned her post. In the comments section, some fans pointed out the apparent changes in her facial features, which netizens seemingly deemed as confirmation of the actress’ pregnancy.
